proves.claim: applyHealthFindings keeps the digest buffer and each reader's last flush in the health-scan event, so three routine findings for one seat over two scans 10 minutes apart get one digest shout naming all three.

store.io-board-health.digest-buffer-pers.why: Without this test, a regression where applyHealthFindings keeps the digest buffer and each reader's last flush in the health-scan event, so three routine findings for one seat over two scans 10 minutes apart get one digest shout naming all three would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: an UNLANDED_HELD finding is shouted in the same scan, and below HEALTH_EPISODE_ENGINE a scan shouts exactly as before.

store.io-board-health.digest-immediate-a.why: Without this test, a regression where an UNLANDED_HELD finding is shouted in the same scan, and below HEALTH_EPISODE_ENGINE a scan shouts exactly as before would pass unnoticed.
